### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **18** documentable anchor(s).

**5** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/meta/view/:name (route, a path literal in semantic; a path literal in surface))_
- `content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/meta/view/:name (route, a path literal in semantic; a path literal in surface))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/index.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/meta/view/:name (route, a path literal in semantic; a path literal in surface))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via field_a (literal, a string literal in LIST_OVERLAY_TYPE_NEEDS_COLUMNS), field_b (literal, a string literal in LIST_OVERLAY_TYPE_NEEDS_COLUMNS))_
- `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/meta/view/:name (route, a path literal in semantic; a path literal in surface))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **136** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ab820016b3e9691870e24a9bbb867336ee5e8f72` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `2d827b1db07765b85b39007edac0bf033daa22b3` — the merge of head `859730effd0edc19c642a77ce03f627837267110` into base `ab820016b3e9691870e24a9bbb867336ee5e8f72`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 2d827b1db07765b85b39007edac0bf033daa22b3 && git checkout 2d827b1db07765b85b39007edac0bf033daa22b3
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin ab820016b3e9691870e24a9bbb867336ee5e8f72 859730effd0edc19c642a77ce03f627837267110 && git checkout -B drift-repro ab820016b3e9691870e24a9bbb867336ee5e8f72 && git merge --no-ff 859730effd0edc19c642a77ce03f627837267110

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ab820016b3e9691870e24a9bbb867336ee5e8f72
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs ab820016b3e9691870e24a9bbb867336ee5e8f72` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `859730effd0edc19c642a77ce03f627837267110`

### ① Derived judgments

- **Method.** Read the card (#20186, all 8 comments, incl. `5854135942`, `5855433719`, `5855518578`, `5855548706`, `5855239789` amended to `Clause-②: yes`, `5856666509`, `5856684897`), the #7494 ruling `5261754173`, #20051 (all 9 comments incl. pointer `5856685597`), the PR body/diff/check-runs, objectui at pin `f8a9d0fb` and cloud `main`. Executed probes in a detached worktree at the head (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, exit 0): a 76-body corpus plus 18 edge bodies run with tsx over `packages/spec/src` at `origin/main` (`ab820016`, staged from `git archive`) and at the head; `z.toJSONSchema` in both directions at both; the PR's save-door file plus a throwaway real-`saveMetaItem` probe on the same ledgered engine double (metadata-protocol closure built JS-only, `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`, exit 0). Probe scripts and raw outputs sit beside this record (`probe.mts`, `probe2.mts`, `probe3.mts`, `compare.out`, `save-door.log`, `spec-files.log`). Worktree removed afterwards.

- **①1 Accept-set census, before vs after — RIGHT.** 76 + 18 bodies, every body at both trees.
  - REFUSE→ACCEPT (7): `W1.layout` (`layout: 'diagonal'`), `W1.sections.bad` (`sections: 'nope'`), `W1.title.bad` (`title: 42`) — W1 exactly (invalid value under a form-only key, dropped unread, parse output `{name,type:'grid',object,viewKind}`); `W2.aria`, `W2.description.i18n`, `W2.sharing.list` (`{type:'personal'}`), `W2.options.map` — W2 exactly (list-legal value under a divergent shared key, kept in the parse). Each was refused on main by the list member at `columns` and never accepted by the form member. **No other widening found**: every other REFUSE stays REFUSE (`overlay.list.identity`, `grid` without columns, calendar without columns, `type: null`, `columns` on a form with `type: 'grid'`, absent-`viewKind` bodies, identity-only bodies).
  - ACCEPT→REFUSE (11 + 8 edge): retired `sort` string (row 1), `direction` alias (row 2), `timeline.metaFields` (row 3), string `searchableFields` (row 4), form-style `sharing` (row 5), mirror `viewKind: 'form'` + `columns: ['name']` (row 7); invalid values under list keys on a column-less, type-less list body — `hiddenFields: 'email'`, `inlineEdit: 'yes'`, `rowHeight: 'gigantic'`, bad `emptyState` key, `userFilters` tab shape, retired filter triple, console `operator: '='`, a `kanban` block missing its own required keys, `appearance.allowedVisualizations: ['calendar']` without a `calendar` block — all row 6 (「any other list key the list view schema refuses … the refusal names the key」, and each refusal does name the key). One class the table does not spell out but row 6 covers: a form body mislabelled `viewKind: 'list'` (`type: 'simple'` + `sections`), accepted on main as a form, refused now at `type` (`invalid_value`, the list enum) with no 「set `viewKind: "form"`」 hint. No real producer writes it (objectui stamps `viewKind` from the tab). Not blocking.
  - Same verdict, changed parse output (declared): every column-less list patch parses to `type: 'grid'` on `listOverlay` with its list keys kept, instead of `type: 'simple'` on `formOverlay` with them stripped. Controls byte-identical: real form overlay, form with `groups`, list with `columns`, authored `type: 'kanban'`/`'calendar'`/`'grid'` with columns, the objectui saved-view fat body.

- **①2 Producer safety (#7494) — RIGHT.** Read at the pin: `buildPersistedViewBody` (`ObjectView.tsx:1065`) returns `{ ...patch, viewKind }` for an overlay; `updateViewConfig` (`data-objectstack/src/index.ts:5318`) stamps `object`, `name`, `_isOverride`; call sites `:2620` (`rowHeight`), `:2625`/`:2923` (`sort`), `:2631`/`:2939` (`hiddenFields`), `:2634`/`:2945` (`columnState`), `:2942` (`inlineEdit`). Probed one body per path plus variants and a batched one: ACCEPT on `listOverlay`, output `type: 'grid'`, at the head; through the real `saveMetaItem` at the head each is `success: true` and the row is the body verbatim (`_isOverride` included). A patch with no `viewKind` and a shadowed registry entry inherits `viewKind: 'list'` (`normalizeViewMetadata`, unchanged) and saves; without a baseline it is refused on both trees (unchanged). No producer write is refused.

- **①3 What reaches storage — RIGHT, and named by the PR.** `saveMetaItem` (`protocol.ts:16154–16208`) persists `request.item` after `graftNormalizedOperators(graftFoldedFormSections(item, parsed.data), parsed.data)`; `withDeclaredPageTypeDefault` is page-only (`protocol.ts:1367`), so no `type` is ever grafted into a view row. Measured: (a) real save at the head — `filter[].operator: 'eq'` on a column-less list patch is stored as `'equals'`; `groups` on a column-less list patch is stored as `groups`; W1 `layout: 'diagonal'` stored as sent; (b) the same bodies on main through the verbatim graft functions (extracted from `protocol.ts` at the head, `grafts.ts`): `eq` stored as `eq` (form member stripped `filter`, so the walk found no counterpart), `groups` stored as `sections` (form fold). Readers: objectui's overlay merge narrows an `_isOverride` row to identity + `rowHeight`/`sort`/`hiddenFields`/`columnState`/`inlineEdit` (`narrowPersonalizationOverlay`, `index.ts:2901`), dropping `filter`/`groups`/`sections`; `listViewOverrides`/`getView` hand the document through unchanged; the rest switcher (`rest-server.ts:7001`) and `getViewsByObject` (`metadata-manager.ts:1727`) filter on `viewKind` + `object` and sort on `order`; the `/forms/:slug` reader takes `viewKind === 'form'` rows only. `eq`→`equals` is the canonical fold every reader already applies (`normalizeFilterOperator`; it already happened on every list overlay WITH `columns`, measured on main), and no reader keyed on the alias was found (objectui's literal `case 'eq'` sites are context-selector / data-scope / record-picker vocabularies, not stored view rows). No reader answers differently for a producer-written row: those rows are byte-identical before and after. Not blocking.

- **①4 Input-side refusal and `.overwrite()` — RIGHT.** `checkListOverlayTypeNeedsColumns` reads `view.type` on a member whose `type` carries no default (`listOverlayPatchFields`), so it sees the input; `_zod.def.type` is `'object'` for both overlay members at the head (no pipe). Served JSON Schema, both directions, main→head, deep-diffed: `anyOf` length 4 at both; members 0 and 1 byte-identical; member 2: `viewKind.enum` `["list","form"]`→`["list"]`, `required` `["columns","object","viewKind"]`→`["object","viewKind"]` (input) and `["type","columns","object","viewKind"]`→`["object","viewKind"]` (output), `properties.type` (incl. `default: 'grid'`) byte-identical; member 3: `viewKind.enum`→`["form"]`, nothing else. Exactly the PR's statement. `.overwrite()` puts `type: 'grid'` only when `type` is absent — authored `kanban`, `calendar`, `grid` with columns come out byte-identical to main; a column-less patch gets `grid` in the shape's key position (`{"name","type":"grid",…}` matches main's default placement on the with-columns control). `overlay.list.identity` (kanban, no columns): REFUSE on both, top-level code `invalid_union` on both; the diagnosis moves from a bare `invalid_union` at `columns` to `custom` at `columns` with the prescription. Note (non-blocking, declared): the served input schema of member 2 is now wider than the parse on the type-bearing column-less class (the check is unrepresentable), and the output schema no longer lists `type` as required although the overwrite always supplies it; `protocol.ts:501/521` serve both directions.

- **①5 Error UX — RIGHT.** At the head, every refused class is located under the arm the body claims: retired `sort` string → `listOverlay`, `invalid_type` at `sort`, message begins 「The bare string `sort` clause was removed from `view.sort` in @objectstack/spec 17.5.0」 (true: that retirement's own text); `timeline.metaFields` → `unrecognized_keys` at `timeline` naming `metaFields`; string `searchableFields` → `invalid_type` at `searchableFields`; form `sharing` → `unrecognized_keys` at `sharing`; type-bearing column-less → `custom` at `columns`, text names both ways out (add `columns`, or drop `type`), and both are true (kanban + columns is ACCEPT; the same body without `type` is ACCEPT as a patch); mirror → `formOverlay`, `invalid_type` at `columns`, 「`columns` is the NUMBER of body columns (an integer, 1 or more)」 — true against `FormViewSchema.columns = z.number().int().min(1).optional()` (`view.zod.ts:4086`; `columns: 2` accepted, `columns: 0` `too_small`). The real save door surfaces the same issues in the 422 `issues[]` (`path: 'sort'` etc.) and in the message. The union's own top-level message stays `Invalid input` for these, as it already does for a with-columns list overlay on main (`retirementPrescription` lifts only `expected: 'never'` tombstones); consistent, not a regression. `overlayViewKindArmMismatch` appears on a direct member parse only, as stated.

- **①6 Pins — RIGHT.** `view-overlay-viewkind-arm.test.ts` asserts branch, top-level codes, issue code + path + prescription text, output `type`, byte-identical controls, member def types and both JSON-schema directions. `protocol.graft-folded-form-sections.test.ts` (+97) asserts `INVALID_METADATA`, 422, zero rows, issue path/code/message per refusal, and row-equals-body per acceptance (the row holds the verbatim body, so an output `type` assertion is not applicable there). Both files run green here (spec: 6 files / 212 tests incl. `view-union-diagnostics`, `view-overlay-options-bag`, `view-union-retirement-prescription`, `view-metadata-schema`, `view-spelling-walk`; metadata-protocol: 2 files / 32 tests incl. my probe). The only flipped existing pins are the three `put.*` output rows (`simple`→`grid`), named in the PR; `overlay.list.identity` is unchanged in the REFUSED table; no existing pin asserts a W1/W2 body refused (swept the 4 test files that name `formOverlay` beside a `viewKind: 'list'` body). Gap, non-blocking: the `direction` alias row of the FROM→TO table has no pin at either door (measured here: ACCEPT on main, REFUSE at `sort.0` at the head).

### ② Semver level

- `'@objectstack/spec': minor` with `**BREAKING**`, `fix(spec)!:` and `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`: the launch-window guard forbids `major` (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, 「During the launch window we ship breaking changes as `minor`」), and the LEVEL axis needs a declared clause ② to grade at least one moved published package `minor` or above — spec is. CI job `Check Changeset` at the head: steps 13 (ADR-0087 disposition) and 15 (no-major) both success.
- `yes (narrowing)` is the ruled spelling for this diff: `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs:93` — 「`yes (narrowing)` — a diff that widens one surface and narrows another. Both facts are true and both are read.」 `breakingDeclaration` (`check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:629`) reads signals `BREAKING`, `bang` and `clause-②-narrowing`, so a disposition is owed and given.
- FROM→TO table: complete against the census in ①1 (rows 1–5 and 7 are the named classes; row 6 is the generic list-key row that covers every other measured narrowing, each refusal naming its key). Widenings W1 and W2 are declared with one measured body each and match the census exactly.
- Disposition `registered view-overlay-judged-by-viewkind-arm` is correct: the semantic entry `18.view-overlay-judged-by-viewkind-arm.ts` is new in this diff and the regenerated registry carries it once; semantic (not a conversion) is right, since which value a refused key meant is the author's. With `main` moved to `fdb26698` (three commits past the merge base, one of them `ca753c01` adding its own step18 entry) `git merge-tree` is clean; the merged registry holds both new ids once and its 188 step18 ids stay in alphabetical order.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **W1 is #20051's persistence half.** Stored as sent (measured at the real door here); the pointer `5856685597` is on #20051 and the PR's Acceptance notes carry the reach and the `origin/main` with-columns control. No separate card is owed.
- **#20230** (overlay `owner`/`hidden`) is serial after this PR: it lands in `flattenedViewOverlayFields`, whose signature this PR changes to `flattenedViewOverlayFields(kind)`; `hidden: true` on a bound list overlay is still accepted at the head (probed).
- **CI at the head**: 39 check-runs, 33 success, 6 skipped, 0 failing, 0 in progress at review close (the earlier in-progress `Test Core (3/6)`, `Test Core (5/6)` and `Type Check · workspace` completed success). The post-merge local rerun the dev declared to CI is therefore covered.
- **Served-schema note** (①4): the list member's input JSON Schema admits a type-bearing column-less body the parse refuses, and its output schema no longer marks `type` required. Declared in the PR; the door remains the judge.
- **Stored-row effects** (①3): `eq`→`equals` and `groups` kept on column-less list patches; named in the PR and pointed to #20051's census. objectui's toolbar never writes `filter` or `groups` into a patch (`onFilterChange` is session state), so no producer row moves.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-20186-view-overlay-viewkind-arm`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Rjy9MeetSfq34PKn81CRiN`

**VERDICT: PASS**
